stories.title: Massive 70lb Dog the Size of Baby Hippo Sheds Pounds and Gets New Home
stories.label: animals
stories.summary: A bulldog named Peggy Sue had grown so overweight she could barely walk, tipping the scales at 70 pounds, which is about the size of a baby hippo. Caring staff at the RSPCA's West Hatch Animal Centre in England took her in and helped her lose the extra weight through a gentle, steady recovery plan. Now healthier and much more mobile, Peggy Sue has found a loving new home where she can enjoy life as a normal-sized, happy dog. It's a sweet reminder of what patience and kindness can do for an animal in need.
stories.why_good: A real rescue animal genuinely recovered her health and was adopted into a loving home, with no suffering or loss at its core, just a feel-good happy ending that already happened.

stories.title: Retired Couple Surprised With New HVAC System Worth $16k in a 'Feel the Love' Program
stories.label: people
stories.summary: An Oregon couple on a tight retirement budget just got a brand-new heating and cooling system installed in their home completely free of charge. Diane and Brian Johnsen had been struggling to keep their house comfortable through hot summers and cold winters, and the $16,000 system means they no longer have to worry about that. The surprise came through a community program called 'Feel the Love,' which has now helped more than 3,100 families with home repairs and upgrades they couldn't otherwise afford. The couple said the gift gives them real peace of mind heading into winter. It's a lovely reminder of how much comfort a caring community can provide.
stories.why_good: A real family received a concrete, already-completed gift that improves their daily life and health through winter, delivered by a nonprofit program with a proven track record of helping thousands — no politics, no disaster, just generosity in action.
